description: Saved Associate in Science in Cybersecurity full-time response

output.content:
Full-time, new student.

### Semester 1

14 units.

- ENC 1101 English Composition 1 (3)
- MAC 1105 College Algebra or STA 2023 Statistical Methods (3)
- CGS 1060C Introduction to Computer Technology and Applications (4)
- CTS 1134 Networking Technologies (4)

### Semester 2

12 units.

- CGS 1700 Introduction to Operating Systems (4)
- CIS 1531 Introduction to Secure Scripting (4)
- CTS 1120 Cybersecurity Fundamentals (4)

### Semester 3

7 units.

- One social science course: AMH 2010 or AMH 2020 or POS 2041 (3)
- CTS 1111 Linux + (4)

### Semester 4

14 units.

- One humanities course: HUM 1020 or PHI 2010 (3)
- One natural science course: BSC 1005 or ESC 1000 or EVR 1001 (3)
- CET 2880C Digital Forensics (4)
- CTS 2314 Network Defense and Countermeasures (4)

### Semester 5

13 units.

- CIS 2350 Cybersecurity Analysis (CySA+) (4)
- 9 units of program electives from the sequence list

Total 60 units.

Certificates named in the sequence:

- Linux+ on CTS 1111 Linux +
- CySA+ on CIS 2350 Cybersecurity Analysis (CySA+)

Portfolio practice:

- A networking lab from CTS 1134
- A short secure-scripting sample from CIS 1531
- A forensics and defense write-up from CET 2880C and CTS 2314

Keep each artifact in a public repo with the course code in the README.

- Configured a small network and documented addressing and services for CTS 1134 Networking Technologies.
- Wrote secure scripts that automate checks covered in CIS 1531 Introduction to Secure Scripting.
- Produced a digital-forensics and network-defense write-up from CET 2880C and CTS 2314, aligned to the CySA+ topics in CIS 2350.
